orgs.estimated_depth: 100+ individual missionaries; 47 Tier A held; search results show extensive per-person page network
orgs.notes: Ethnos360 publishes per-person pages on two surfaces: (1) path on main domain at ethnos360.org/missionaries/<firstname>-and-<firstname>-<lastname>/, slug format with hyphen-separated names; (2) dedicated blog network at blogs.ethnos360.org/<firstname>-<lastname>/ with per-missionary blogs and individual give pages (blogs.ethnos360.org/<name>/give/). Confirmed stable URL patterns on both.

orgs.estimated_depth: Hundreds of missionaries in centralized directory with pagination (page parameters suggest 50+ pages)
orgs.notes: Wycliffe operates a centralized paginated/searchable missionaries directory at wycliffe.org/partner/missionaries with query parameters (?page=3, ?mview=true, ?filter[0][]=1) but NO stable per-person URL pattern. Donors give via a shared directory, not individual per-person giving pages. This is a valid 'none' result confirming no per-person pattern.

orgs.estimated_depth: 236 full-time missionaries; per-person pages at stable URLs
orgs.notes: WGM publishes per-person missionary pages at wgm.org/missionary/<lastname> format. Confirmed pattern with examples: Bob Margaron (margaron), Bill and Lydia Allshouse (allshouse). Also found wgm.org/sensitive-missionary for missionaries in restricted areas. Per-person giving form accessible on each page.

orgs.estimated_depth: ~300 full-time missionaries; additional missionaries in sensitive areas accessible via Express Give
orgs.notes: OMS publishes per-person pages at onemissionsociety.org/missionaries/detail/<identifier> where identifier appears to be last name or slug format. Confirmed pattern with examples (Lydia/gard, Shane/Christopher, Chunillal/Pema, Nancy/Nancy, Aimee/howarth). Note: Some missionaries in sensitive areas not publicly listed but still accessible via Express Give option (account number entry). Per-person giving pages confirmed.
